intent: Eight individually authored gratitude, hope, fear and emotion tasks distinguish recipients, purposes, advice and known outcomes.
picturePurpose: Original raised-kite/ground-kite comparison supports visible position; the written record supplies past movement and joy. A qualitative fear-direction control has no invented amount or permanent cure.

workshop.title: 看清愿望、程度和目的
workshop.instruction: 调变化、辨位置，再把感谢对象、已做动作和未知结果分开。

items.label: thankful：感激的是哪件事
items.prompt: Keep the reason for gratitude, without inventing a journey outcome.
items.material: We were thankful for the driver's patience.
items.reason: be thankful for后接感激的事情。the driver’s patience是司机的耐心，不是车速，也不说明后来是否安全到家。
items.hint: for后找原因，不补路程结果。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the reason for gratitude, without inventing a journey outcome.

recordSelection.title: 感激的原因不换成车速
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: Thankful for patience
rows.text: The group felt thankful for the driver’s patience.

rows.label: Thankful for fast driving
rows.text: The driver’s speed was the stated reason.

rows.label: Safe arrival proved
rows.text: Everyone had definitely arrived home safely.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选Thankful for patience；车速和到家都没有依据。

options.text: The group was grateful because the driver drove very fast.
options.reason: patience不是驾驶速度。

options.text: The group felt thankful for the driver’s patience.
options.reason: for后面是感激的事情：司机的耐心。

options.text: The sentence proves everyone arrived home safely.
options.reason: 没有交代旅程结果。

items.label: grateful：感激的人要找对
items.prompt: Keep who is thanked, and why those people are included.
items.material: I am grateful to everyone who helped me practise.
items.after: to everyone who helped me practise.
items.reason: be grateful to somebody表示感激某人。everyone who helped me practise指每一位帮我练习的人，不是没有范围的全世界所有人。help somebody do和help somebody to do都可以；此处保留原句practise。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep who is thanked, and why those people are included.

recordSelection.title: every的范围由从句限定
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: All the practice helpers
rows.text: The speaker thanks everyone who helped with practice.

rows.label: Every person anywhere
rows.text: The speaker thanks every person in the world regardless of help.

rows.label: Nobody helped
rows.text: No one helped the speaker practise.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选All the practice helpers；别扩大范围或抹掉帮助。

options.text: The sentence thanks every person in the world, including people who did not help.
options.reason: 不能漏掉who helped me practise的范围。

options.text: The speaker says no one helped with practice.
options.reason: helped明确写了有人帮助。

options.text: The speaker is grateful to all the people who helped with practice.
options.reason: everyone受who从句限定：帮过我练习的人。

items.label: hope：希望，不是结果报告
items.prompt: Keep the hope without claiming the winter outcome is known.
items.material: I hope the young tree survives the winter.
items.after: the young tree survives the winter.
items.reason: hope后可以接从句；这里the young tree是从句主语，survives与单数主语呼应。hope表达希望，不能据此认定已经熬过冬天。可以说hope to do，不能把这里改成hope the tree to survive。
items.hint: 看hope从句，不把愿望变成已完成。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the hope without claiming the winter outcome is known.

recordSelection.title: 希望和已知结果分开
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: Hope of surviving winter
rows.text: The speaker hopes the tree survives winter.

rows.label: Survival already proved
rows.text: The tree has definitely survived the winter already.

rows.label: Wants the tree to die
rows.text: The speaker wants the tree to die in winter.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选Hope of surviving winter；已知结果和相反愿望都不成立。

options.text: The speaker hopes the young tree will survive the winter.
options.reason: hope表达希望，结果尚不能据此确定。

options.text: The sentence proves the tree has already survived the winter.
options.reason: 希望不是已经发生的结果。

options.text: The speaker wants the young tree to die in winter.
options.reason: 与survives的愿望相反。

items.label: wish：祝愿谁一路平安
items.prompt: Keep the wish and recipient, without turning it into a completed journey.
items.material: I wish you a safe journey home.
items.reason: wish somebody something可表达祝愿。you是收到祝愿的人，a safe journey home是祝愿的内容。这不是报告已经安全到家；也不能把wish直接换成hope而保留you a safe journey这种结构。
items.hint: 分清祝愿对象、内容和实际结果。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the wish and recipient, without turning it into a completed journey.

recordSelection.title: 祝愿对象是you
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: Wish for the listener
rows.text: The listener receives a wish for a safe journey home.

rows.label: Arrival already proved
rows.text: The listener has already arrived home safely.

rows.label: Only the speaker travels
rows.text: The sentence only wishes the speaker a safe journey.

recordSelection.hint: you是对象，是否到家还没有说。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Wish for the listener；别换对象或补到达。

options.text: The sentence proves the listener has already arrived home safely.
options.reason: 祝愿不是到达记录。

options.text: The speaker wishes the listener a safe journey home.
options.reason: wish somebody something：向you祝愿回家旅途平安。

options.text: Only the speaker’s own journey is being described.
options.reason: you是收到祝愿的人，不是I。

items.label: fear：减轻，不等于彻底消失
items.prompt: Set the change in fear, then keep the limit of the claim.
items.material: A little information helped reduce my fear.
items.before: A little information helped reduce my
items.reason: fear在my fear中是名词，表示恐惧。helped reduce说明信息帮助减轻了恐惧，不等于全部消失，更不保证永远不再害怕。不要把a little information读成没有信息。
items.hint: 先定减轻方向，再保留程度限制。

wordDecision.prompt: Set the change in fear, then keep the limit of the claim.

shift.title: 信息带来怎样的变化
shift.hint: 只标恐惧感变化方向，不编具体数值，也不保证完全消失。
shift.wrong: reduce是减轻，不是不变或加重；也不能扩大成恐惧永远消失。

options.text: All fear disappeared permanently.
options.reason: reduce不保证完全消失或永不再有。

options.text: The information is stated to have increased the fear.
options.reason: increase与reduce方向相反。

options.text: Some information helped reduce the speaker’s fear.
options.reason: reduce说减轻，helped说明起到了帮助。

items.label: worry：不用担心，是劝告
items.prompt: Keep the reassurance without inventing a past emotional record.
items.material: Do not worry about asking for help.
items.reason: Do not worry about是劝人不要为……担心。about是介词，后面用asking，不用ask。原句没有禁止求助，也不能证明对方过去从未担心或以后绝不担心。
items.hint: 劝的是不用担心，不是别去求助。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the reassurance without inventing a past emotional record.

recordSelection.title: 不要担心，不是禁止求助
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: Reassurance about help
rows.text: The listener is advised not to worry about asking for help.

rows.label: Never worried before
rows.text: The listener is proved never to have worried before.

rows.label: Asking is forbidden
rows.text: The listener is forbidden to ask for help.

recordSelection.hint: about asking说担心的事，不是禁令。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Reassurance about help；过去感受和禁止求助都没有写。

options.text: The listener is told not to worry about asking for help.
options.reason: Do not提出劝告，about后是求助这件事。

options.text: The listener is proved never to have worried before.
options.reason: 劝告不证明过去从未担心。

options.text: The sentence forbids the listener to ask for help.
options.reason: 不要担心求助，不是禁止求助。

items.label: anger：目的是控制，不等于已经成功
items.prompt: Keep the breath and its purpose, without claiming success.
items.material: She took a deep breath to control her anger.
items.before: She took a deep breath to control her
items.reason: anger在her anger中是名词；angry是形容词。took是take的过去式，took a deep breath表示深吸一口气。to control说明目的，不能据此认定已经成功控制住了怒气。
items.hint: 把已做的动作和想达到的目的分开。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the breath and its purpose, without claiming success.

recordSelection.title: 动作已做，效果仍需证据
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: Aim → control her anger
rows.text: Her aim was to control her anger.

rows.label: Success already proved
rows.text: She definitely controlled all her anger successfully.

recordSelection.hint: 动作和目的都保留，成功不能补。
recordSelection.wrong: 选Took a deep breath和Aim → control her anger；原句没有报告成功。

options.text: The sentence proves she successfully controlled all her anger.
options.reason: 目的不能直接变成成功记录。

options.text: She took a deep breath with the aim of controlling her anger.
options.reason: to control说明深呼吸的目的，不保证目的已经实现。

options.text: She took a breath to control another person’s anger.
options.reason: her anger指她自己的怒气，不是别人的。

items.label: joy：图找位置，文字找感受
items.prompt: The record says the kite rose. Tap the view showing the kite up in the air.
items.material: The children shouted with joy when the kite rose.
items.reason: with joy表示充满喜悦；joy是名词。when the kite rose给出孩子们欢呼时的事件，rose是rise的过去式。图片只能帮助辨认空中与地面，不能单靠静图证明先前上升的动作，也不能靠表情猜喜悦。
items.hint: 位置看图，时间和喜悦看文字。

wordDecision.prompt: The record says the kite rose. Tap the view showing the kite up in the air.

art.alt: 两个对照画面：左边学生牵着的风筝高在空中，右边相同风筝放在草地上。

evidence.caption: A的风筝在空中。上升动作和孩子们的喜悦由原句说明，不靠静图推断。
B的风筝放在草地上，不是空中位置；图不判断孩子们的感受。

options.text: B: the kite is resting on the grass.
options.reason: B的风筝在地面，不是空中位置。

options.text: A: the kite is up in the air.
options.reason: A的风筝在空中；rose和joy由原句说明，静图不证明之前的动作和感受。

transfer.stem: Which notes keep hopes, reduced feelings and purposes accurate?
transfer.passage:
SCHOOL KITE DAY NOTES
We were thankful for our driver’s patience. I was grateful to everyone who helped me practise tying the string. These notes do not say the driver drove fast.
I hope the young tree near the gate survives the winter. Winter is not over, so its later survival is not known. Before Mei left, I said, “I wish you a safe journey home.” We had not received news of her arrival.
A little information about the activity helped reduce my fear, but some fear remained. Our teacher said, “Do not worry about asking for help.” This was reassurance, not a ban on asking.
When her string tangled, Jia took a deep breath to control her anger. The notes do not say whether it worked. Later the kite rose, and the children shouted with joy.

options.text: The tree’s survival is only hoped for; some fear remained; the deep breath had a purpose without a proved result.
The tree has already survived winter; some fear remained; the deep breath had a purpose without a proved result.
The tree’s survival is only hoped for; all fear disappeared forever; the deep breath had a purpose without a proved result.
The tree’s survival is only hoped for; some fear remained; the breath proves Jia successfully controlled all her anger.

answer.display: The tree’s survival is only hoped for; some fear remained; the deep breath had a purpose without a proved result.

explanation.strategy: 先区分希望和已知结果，再核对reduce的程度，最后分清目的和效果。

steps.text: 冬天还没结束，小树熬过冬天只是希望；恐惧减轻后仍有一部分。
steps.reason: not over和some fear remained直接限制结论，不能补成已经存活或永远不怕。

steps.text: 深呼吸是已做的动作，控制怒气是目的，是否奏效没有写。
steps.reason: to control表达目的；the notes do not say whether it worked明确没有证明成功。

distractors.reason: 希望被改成已经发生，违背冬天尚未结束。
some fear remained被改成恐惧永远全部消失。
目的被改成成功控制怒气的证据。

explanation.pitfall: 把希望、劝告或目的读成已实现的结果，把减轻扩大成完全消失。

visual.title: 愿望、程度、目的
visual.caption: 按原文限定结论，不把意图和程度扩大。

explanation.transfer: “祝你一路平安”能证明对方已到家吗？“深呼吸来控制怒气”能证明已经奏效吗？
